# YDITS Website

> [YDITS website](https://www.ydits.net/) is the YDITS official website.

## About YDITS

YDITS is the service that quickly provides users with optimal disaster prevention information.

### Operator of YDITS

YDITS's operator is "よね/Yone".

- [よね/Yone's Website](https://www.yoneyo.com/)
- [よね/Yone's Website LLMs.txt](https://www.yoneyo.com/llms.txt)

### YDITS's Works

Application development, Disaster prevention services.

## Applications by YDITS

- YDITS for Web
- YDITS for Desktop
- YDITS for Mobile

- [YDITS for Web Website](https://www.ydits.net/apps/web/)

Developing.

## Services by YDITS

- YDITS API

### YDITS API

**YDITS API** is an API for developers to quickly distribute disaster prevention information by YDITS.

Developing.

- [YDITS API Documents](https://www.ydits.net/api/)
